title: AWS Feature Relevance Notification System
description: GenAI powered workflow that scores and notifies through slack if a given AWS feature is relevant for a given workload
usecase: AWS publishes more than 200 feature announcements every month. Identifying which announcement benefits a given workload is a challenging task. This GenAI powered system with Step Functions orchestration scores the relevance of a feature and sends Notification to slack channel, thus enabling customers to automatically curate announcements that are beneficial for a given workload.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This workflow demonstrates a GenAI system orchestrated by Step Functions workflow that reads AWS What's new RSS feeds and scores a new feature for it's relevance against a given workload profile.
The Step Functions workflow will also send notification to a slack channel if the AWS feature is relevant to a given workload profile.
